data.gender_notes: Binny is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Binny is derived from the Sanskrit term 'Bindu', which refers to the cosmic dot or the divine point. In Hindu mythology, Bindu symbolizes the source of creation, consciousness, and spiritual awakening. The name Binny is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, knowledge, and inner peace. The name Binny carries the meaning “Bindu, the cosmic dot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Binny usually hope their child will grow to embody bindu, the cosmic dot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
